product_updates.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
product_updates.content: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

product_updates.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
product_updates.content: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

product_updates.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
product_updates.content: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.

product_updates.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
product_updates.content: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.

product_updates.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
product_updates.content: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

product_updates.title: ElevenLabs’ new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams

product_updates.title: Israel’s VCs see opportunity for challengers in Nvidia’s turmoil
product_updates.content: Given Nvidia’s stronghold on AI and its importance in Israel, many in the country's startup ecosystem are worried about the impact of his departure.

product_updates.title: Jensen Huang didn’t show confidence in his successor, report says
product_updates.content: Huang described Kress as a "deer in the headlights" during a meeting in summer.
